dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seen anyone around who looks a fair bit like me?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Ahhchoo! ...I've been patrolling the wharf the whole time, but I can't say I've seen anyone who looks like you.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I could always have missed something...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: After sticking with the cats for too long, I've gotten bad at remembering faces. I even mistook our sergeant for some old fellow asking for directions...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Ah... Ah... I will keep a look out when I'm on patrol in future. While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevACHOO!
